issues.detail: The Greek 'πυκνας' (pyknas) is not a standard word for 'thường xuyên' (frequent/constant). It appears to be a corruption or non-standard form. However, more importantly, the Vietnamese translation adds the concept of 'thường xuyên' (frequently) which is not present in the Greek text provided.

The Greek phrase 'δια τον στομαχον σου' (for your stomach) is translated as 'vì cớ dạ dày con'. While 'vì cớ' is a stylistic choice, the primary issue is the addition of 'thường xuyên' which alters the scope of the description of the 'weakness'.
